note: A structured record of what the order form says, one field per term, each with the passage it comes from and the exact words (and, for a term a redline replaces, the whole sentence). Hand-written, standing in for an extraction step; a test checks every quote and clause against the contract text.

parties.quote: between Brightwater Metrics, Inc., a Delaware corporation

orderOfPrecedence.quote: Brightwater's website terms do not apply

productScope.value: Brightwater Product Analytics: product usage events
productScope.quote: Brightwater Product Analytics for up to 25 million events a month

initialTermMonths.quote: twenty-four (24) months from the start date

renewalTermMonths.quote: renews for successive twelve (12) month terms

renewalNoticeDays.quote: at least thirty (30) days before the end of the then-current term

paymentDays.quote: within thirty (30) days of the invoice date
paymentDays.clause: Invoices are payable within thirty (30) days of the invoice date.

priceIncreasePct.quote: Prices are fixed for the first term

liabilityCapMonths.quote: the fees paid or payable in the twelve (12) months before the claim

ipIndemnity.quote: Brightwater will defend Northstar against third-party claims that the service infringes

processesCustomerPersonalData.quote: includes personal data such as user ids and email addresses

dataProcessingAddendum.quote: only under the Data Processing Addendum attached as Exhibit A

breachNoticeHours.quote: within forty-eight (48) hours of discovering it

securityProgram.value: security program, encryption, SSO, training; no audit reports

usageData.quote: Brightwater may use only aggregated, de-identified metrics

confidentialityYearsAfter.quote: for three (3) years after it ends

terminationForConvenienceDays.quote: for convenience on sixty (60) days' written notice
terminationForConvenienceDays.clause: Northstar may end the subscription for convenience on sixty (60) days' written notice, with a refund of prepaid fees for the unused period.

assignment.quote: except to a successor in a merger or sale of its business

insurance.quote: cyber liability insurance of at least $5,000,000 per claim
